levels.text: Shizu draws her great katana at blinding speed, dealing 1 physical attack equal to 130% of her ATK to 3 random enemies.
Shizu focuses all of her power into using the full weight of her great katana to cut the enemy down, dealing 1 physical attack equal to 200% of her ATK to 1 random enemy.
Focusing all of her strength, Zara deals 1 physical attack equal to 480% of her ATK to the enemy directly in front of her, and has a 50% chance to inflict [Fainted] on them for 1 turn.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 520% of her ATK.
The chance to inflict [Fainted] becomes 70%.
Zara’s magical power propels her at high speeds towards the enemy, dealing 1 physical attack equal to 410% of her ATK to the enemy directly in front of her and the 2 enemies adjacent to that target.
Additionally has a 50% chance to decrease all targets’ SPD by 10% for 3 turns.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 480% of her ATK.
The amount all targets’ SPD decreases by becomes 20%.

Zara uses her magic power to strengthen her defenses. At the start of each turn or when Zara is attacked, if her remaining HP percentage falls below 30%, this skill decreases the damage she takes by 20% (cannot be dispelled). At the start of each turn, if her remaining HP percentage is 30% or higher, [Decreased Damage Taken] is dispelled.
The decrease in damage she takes becomes 30%.

Rosalie takes the staff she inherited from her old master and releases its power, dealing 1 magical attack equal to 290% of her ATK to 4 random enemies. This ancient magic steals the enemies’ life force, restoring HP equal to 10% of this skill’s total damage to Rosalie.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 320% of her ATK.
The targets of this skill become 5 random enemies.

The power of Rosalie’s old master that dwells within her awakens, dealing 1 magical attack equal to 420% of her ATK to 2 random enemies. Her old master’s will to protect her grants [Invulnerable] to Rosalie for 1 turn.
Additionally has a 60% chance to inflict [Bleed] on all targets for 2 turns. Each turn, at the start of the action phase, [Bleed] deals damage equal to 10% of Rosalie’s ATK.
The targets of the magical attack become 3 random enemies.
The number of turns of [Invulnerable] becomes 2.

Rosalie is protected by the life she inherited from her fallen master. At the start of the battle, this skill grants [Regeneration] to Rosalie (cannot be dispelled). Each turn, at the start of the action phase, [Regeneration] restores HP equal to 5% of Rosalie’s max HP to her.
The amount [Regeneration] restores Rosalie’s HP by becomes equal to 10% of her max HP.

This maiden in love takes aim and shoots the enemy down. Libra’s love becomes her power, dealing 1 physical attack equal to 410% of her ATK to the enemy with the lowest current HP. If the target’s remaining HP percentage is 50% or lower, this attack is guaranteed to hit.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 430% of her ATK.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 450% of her ATK.

This maiden in love’s power inspires her to take action. When Libra parted ways with her envy-filled past, an immense power begins to stir within her, dealing 1 physical attack equal to 380% of her ATK to 3 random enemies. This fierce attack driven by love has a 70% chance to decrease all targets’ DEF by 50% for 2 turns.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 410% of her ATK.
The amount all targets’ DEF decreases by becomes 65%.
The chance to inflict [Decreased DEF] becomes 100%.
This maiden continues to think about nothing but love. Libra won’t let anyone other than the one she loves grab hold of her. Increases her chance to evade by 20% (cannot be dispelled).
The increase in her chance to evade becomes 30%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Emma, Attack! The targets of this skill become 5 random enemies.
Strengthens Playing With Dolls♪. The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 640% of her ATK.
Strengthens Emma, Attack! The direct attack’s damage becomes equal to 380% of her DEX.

levels.text: “Go get ’em, Emma!” yells Ivy. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 420% of her ATK to 3 random enemies. “Hmm, they’re not really red, huh? I’ll go and stain them!” she says. Deals 1 direct attack equal to 320% of Ivy’s DEX to the enemy with the highest remaining HP percentage.
Additionally, if her remaining HP percentage is 35% or lower, the direct attack’s damage is multiplied by 2.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 530% of her ATK.

Ivy gives red dresses to old dolls as presents. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 420% of her ATK to the enemy with the lowest remaining HP percentage. The number of attacks this skill deals increases by 1 for each buff Ivy is enhanced with (3 total attacks max). She says “You need more red.” If the target is afflicted with a debuff, the physical attack’s damage is multiplied by 1.5.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 540% of her ATK.
The max total number of physical attacks becomes 5.
The physical attacks become guaranteed to hit.

The more Ivy sees red dripping from her favorite dolls, the more her “red obsession” awakens from within her. At the start of the battle, this skill increases Ivy’s ATK by 20% for 7 turns. When an ally is defeated, Ivy’s ATK is further increased by 20% (5 stacks, total increase of 100% max). Each time this buff increases her ATK, the buff’s remaining number of turns is extended to 7.
The increases in her ATK at the start of the battle and her ATK when an ally is defeated each become 30% (5 stacks, total increase of 150% max).
The increases in her ATK at the start of the battle and her ATK when an ally is defeated each become 50% (5 stacks, total increase of 250% max).

Ivy asks, “What kind of red do you have?” and strengthens her basic attack. When she deals a basic attack, she instead deals 1 physical attack equal to 120% of her ATK to 1 random enemy. “I found you~!” she says as she discovers new dolls to play with, and leaps at them with joy. If the target’s SPD is lower than Ivy’s SPD, this skill has a 30% chance to inflict [Fainted] on them for 1 turn.
The targets of the physical attack become 2 random enemies.
The chance to inflict [Fainted] becomes 50%.

members.name: The Witch of Snowy Illusions · Lunalynn
The Witch of Budding Doom · Meria

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Like Master Would Do. Additionally, if the target’s remaining HP percentage is below 50%, restores HP equal to 350% of Merlyn’s ATK to them. If the target’s remaining HP percentage is 50% or higher, increases their CRIT DMG Boost by 20% for 2 turns.
Strengthens Like Master Would Do. The targets of this skill become the 2 allies with the highest ATK, and the number of debuffs that are dispelled becomes 2.
Strengthens Like Master Would Do. The amount all targets’ CRIT DMG Boost increases by becomes 40%.

levels.text: Merlyn remembers the lessons her master taught her and saves her friends—just like her master did for her long ago. If the ally with the highest ATK is afflicted with a debuff, this skill dispels 1 debuff from them.
Additionally, if the target is not afflicted with a debuff, increases their ATK by 30% for 2 turns.
The amount the target’s ATK increases by becomes 40%.

Merlyn unleashes a stream of ivy at the enemy and sweeps them away. Anyone entangled in its vines has their power drained away. Dispels 1 buff each from the 2 enemies with the highest remaining HP percentages, and deals 1 magical attack to equal to 320% of Merlyn’s ATK to all targets.
Additionally restores HP equal to 15% of this skill’s total damage to the ally with the lowest remaining HP percentage.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 380% of her ATK.
The targets of the magical attack become the 3 enemies with the highest remaining HP percentages.

Merlyn asks, “W-Won’t you become...my apprentice?” At the start of each turn, if 3 or more allies are alive, this skill increases the chance to deal a critical hit of both Merlyn and 1 adjacent ally by 20% (cannot be dispelled). If the number of allies who are alive is 2 or less, this skill instead increases the DEF of both Merlyn and 1 adjacent ally by 20% (cannot be dispelled).
The increases in all targets’ DEF and chance to deal a critical hit each become 40%.
The targets of this skill become Merlyn and 2 adjacent allies.

A master guides their apprentice, and protects them. At the start of each turn or when Merlyn is attacked, if her remaining HP percentage is below 50%, this skill grants [Regeneration] to both Merlyn and 1 adjacent ally (cannot be dispelled). Each turn, at the start of the action phase, [Regeneration] restores HP equal to 3% of an enhanced target’s max HP to them.
The amount [Regeneration] restores an enhanced target’s HP by becomes equal to 5% of their max HP.
The targets of this skill become Merlyn and 2 adjacent allies.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens The Quick & The Dead. Additionally, before dealing the physical attacks, decreases all targets’ DEF by 80% for 1 turn.
Strengthens The Quick & The Dead. The number of turns of [Decreased DEF] and [Increased ATK] each become 2.
Strengthens The Quick & The Dead. The number of physical attacks becomes 5.

levels.text: Cordie’s quick shot performance is a specialty among specialties. Deals 4 physical attacks equal to 420% of her ATK to enemies at random.
Additionally, if a target is defeated by this skill, increases Cordie’s ATK by 50% for 1 turn.
The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 570% of her ATK.

With its blinding speed, Cordie’s rapid-fire shooting has now reached the level of an acrobatic performance. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 390% of her ATK to 5 random enemies. The thrill she experiences greatly boosts her focus, and if Cordie’s remaining HP percentage is 50% or lower, the physical attack’s damage is multiplied by 1.5.
Additionally, if a target is afflicted with a debuff, this skill is guaranteed to deal a critical hit to that target.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 520% of her ATK.
If her remaining HP percentage is 50% or lower, the physical attack’s damage is multiplied by 2.
As onlookers keep their eyes glued to Cordie, her senses begin to heighten. Increases her ATK by 30% (cannot be dispelled).
Additionally increases her DEF Break by 30% (cannot be dispelled).
The amounts her ATK and DEF Break increase by each become 40%.

Cordie always confuses others with her behavior. The scent of gunpowder doesn’t help, either. At the start of the turn, this skill grants [Unhindered] to her for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled). This skill will not activate again until 3 action phases have ended since its previous activation.
The number of turns of [Unhindered] becomes 3.
[Unhindered] changes to [Debuff Immunity].

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Lost Child’s Tears. The chance to steal 1 buff from a target becomes 100%.
Strengthens I Hate You!! If a target’s DEX is lower than Nina’s DEX, additionally has a 50% chance to decrease that target’s chance to hit by 30% for 4 turns.
Strengthens Lost Child’s Tears. The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 480% of her ATK.

levels.text: When a lost child starts crying, they won’t stop. Nina throws a tantrum, dealing 1 physical attack equal to 305% of her ATK to 5 random enemies. She cries, “I’m not lost!” Before dealing the physical attack, if a target is enhanced with a buff, this skill has a 60% chance to steal 1 buff from that target. If the target is not enhanced with a buff, this skill decreases that target’s chance to inflict a debuff by 40% for 2 turns.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 380% of her ATK.
The chance to steal 1 buff from a target becomes 80%.

Nina cries, “Stop it!” Deals 1 physical attack equal to 305% of her ATK to 5 random enemies. She then says, “This is what bad kids get!” Before dealing the physical attack, if a target’s DEX is lower than Nina’s DEX, this skill dispels 1 debuff from Nina, and has a 80% chance to copy the dispelled debuff’s effect on that target.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 380% of her ATK.
The chance to dispel her debuff and copy it on a target becomes 100%.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 480% of her ATK.
Until she finds her way home, Nina won’t stop walking. Increases her chance to evade by 20% (cannot be dispelled).
Additionally decreases the damage she takes by 20% (cannot be dispelled).
The increase in her chance to evade becomes 30%, and the decrease in the damage she takes becomes 30%.
The more tears Nina sheds, the darker her shadow becomes. When she is attacked and takes damage that exceeds 10% of her current HP, the exceeding amount of damage is cut by 35%.
The amount of damage that exceeds 10% of her current HP is cut by 45%.
The amount of damage that exceeds 10% of her current HP is cut by 65%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Life Conversion. The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 410% of her ATK.
Strengthens Maintenance. The amount the target’s ATK increases by becomes 85%.
Strengthens Maintenance. Additionally increases the DEF of the ally with the highest ATK by 65% for 3 turns.

levels.text: Mertillier will use any power she can to protect A.A.—even the power of demons. Deals 1 magical attack equal to 290% of her ATK to 4 random enemies, and grants Mertillier [Shield] equal to 25% of this skill’s total damage for 3 turns.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 350% of her ATK.
The size of [Shield] becomes equal to 40% of this skill’s total damage.

If there’s anything wrong with A.A., no matter how slight the change is, Mertillier won’t fail to see it. She understands “life” more than anyone else and utilizes her expertise, decreasing the skill cooldown time of the ally with the highest ATK by 1.
Additionally increases the target’s ATK by 65% for 3 turns.
Additionally, if the target is afflicted with a debuff, all their debuffs are dispelled.
The amount the target’s skill cooldown time decreases by becomes 2.

Mertillier created her homunculus body so she can protect her dear A.A. At the start of each turn or when Mertillier is attacked, if her remaining HP percentage is below 40%, this skill grants [Regeneration] to her for 4 turns (cannot be dispelled). Each turn, at the start of the action phase, [Regeneration] restores HP equal to 15% of Mertillier’s max HP to her.
The amount [Regeneration] restores Mertillier’s HP by becomes equal to 20% of her max HP.
Additionally grants [Stealth] to her for 4 turns (cannot be dispelled).
Mertillier has applied everything she learned from many years of homunculus research onto her own body. Increases her chance to resist a debuff by 30% (cannot be dispelled).
The increase in her chance to resist a debuff becomes 50%.
The increase in her chance to resist a debuff becomes 100%.

exclusiveEffects.text: At the start of each turn, restores HP equal to 5% of Luke’s ATK to her.
The amount Luke’s HP is restored by becomes equal to 20% of her ATK.
The amount Luke’s HP is restored by becomes equal to 25% of her ATK.

levels.text: Although Luke follows a different path, her pride has not changed. In the end, she will bring death to her foes with one blow. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 460% of Luke’s ATK to 5 random enemies. If a target’s STR is lower than Luke’s STR, this attack is guaranteed to deal a critical hit to that target. Luke also deals 1 direct attack equal to 150% of her STR to the enemy with the highest STR.
Additionally decreases the ATK of the enemy with the highest STR by 50% for 1 turn (this decrease is calculated towards the target’s ATK at the time of this skill’s activation).
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 540% of her ATK.

Swearing on her knight’s pride, Luke pours her entire soul into this strike. Dispels every [Shield] from 1 random enemy, and deals 1 direct attack equal to 400% of Luke’s STR to them. This attack ignores [Invulnerable], [Shield], and [Multi-Barrier] if the target is enhanced with any of them.
The direct attack’s damage becomes equal to 480% of her STR.
Additionally, before dispelling [Shield], if the target is not enhanced with [Shield], the direct attack’s damage is multiplied by 1.5.
The direct attack’s damage becomes equal to 520% of her STR.
A fate loved by “death” erodes even the soul. If Luke attacks and deals a critical hit, this skill increases the damage the target takes by 5% (5 stacks max).
The increase in damage the target takes becomes 10%.
The increase in damage the target takes becomes 15%.

Luke fights against the fate of death that looms over her. That determination becomes her power. At the start of the battle, this skill increases her chance to resist a critical hit by 30% for 4 turns.
The increase in her chance to resist a critical hit becomes 60%.
At the start of the battle, additionally increases 1 adjacent ally’s chance to resist a critical hit by 60% for 3 turns.

Using a secret skill inherited from the previous chief, Garmr deals 1 physical attack equal to 130% of her ATK to 1 random enemy. This special bandit’s arrow is laced with a toxin that prevents blood from clotting, and has a 50% chance to inflict [Bleed] on the target for 2 turns. Each turn, at the start of the action phase, [Bleed] deals damage equal to 20% of Garmr’s ATK.

Garmr shoots down enemies who are targeting her allies, dealing 1 physical attack equal to 110% of her ATK to 3 random enemies. She continues firing arrows to hold the enemies back, decreasing all targets’ SPD by 20% for 2 turns.

Skuld uses a strange liquid created from a failed attempt at developing a new elixir, dealing 1 magical attack equal to 320% of her ATK to 1 random enemy. Hazardous side effects decrease the target’s ATK by 10% for 2 turns.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 360% of her ATK.
The amount the target’s ATK decreases by becomes 20%.
Skuld uses a therapeutic aroma to treat her allies’ fatigue, restoring HP equal to 210% of her MAG to the 2 allies with the lowest current HP.
The amount all targets’ HP is restored by becomes equal to 230% of Skuld’s MAG.
Additionally increases all targets’ SPD by 20% for 2 turns.
The targets of this skill become the 3 allies with the lowest current HP.

After continuously making improvement after improvement, Skuld creates a special elixir that treats fatigue and increases stamina. Drinking it increases her max HP by 20% (cannot be dispelled). But, she cannot vouch for its taste.
The amount her max HP increases by becomes 30%.
Paint enriched with magic power spatters from the tip of Cherna’s brush, dealing 5 magical attacks equal to 210% of her ATK to enemies at random.
The magical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 230% of her ATK.
Additionally, each time this skill deals a critical hit, increases Cherna’s ATK by 10% for 1 turn (5 stacks, 50% max).

With the desire to fill her canvas with layers upon layers of brilliance, Cherna deals 1 magical attack equal to 360% of her ATK to 1 random enemy. Her magic-enriched brushwork also has a 50% chance to inflict [Fainted] and [Bleed] on the target for 1 turn. Each turn, at the start of the action phase, [Bleed] deals damage equal to 10% of Cherna’s ATK.
The targets of this skill become 2 random enemies.
The chance to inflict [Fainted] and [Bleed] becomes 70%.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 390% of her ATK.
By painting a monochrome portrait onto her magical canvas, Cherna begins to slowly steal the enemy’s life force away. Increases her HP Drain by 20% (cannot be dispelled)
The amount her HP Drain increases by becomes 30%.
“Eeny meeny miny moe!” chants Soteira while aimlessly firing off some magic. Deals 6 magical attacks equal to 160% of her ATK to enemies at random.
The number of magical attacks becomes 8.
The magical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 190% of her ATK.

Soteira yells, “Look!” and points to the sky. But, she sure fooled them—there’s nothing there! Deals 1 magical attack equal to 390% of her ATK to the enemy with the highest SPD, and decreases their SPD by 20% for 3 turns.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 420% of her ATK.
The amount the target’s SPD decreases by becomes 30%.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 480% of her ATK.

Dezzy is half-asleep, but keeps poking her beak at the enemy. When Soteira is attacked, this skill has a 30% chance to inflict [Bleed] on the enemy that attacked her for 1 turn. Each turn, at the start of the action phase, [Bleed] deals damage equal to 20% of Soteira’s ATK.
The chance to inflict [Bleed] becomes 50%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Wild Claw. The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 340% of her ATK.
Strengthens Feline Waltz. The targets who are granted [Shield] become Mimi and the ally with the lowest remaining HP percentage.
Strengthens Feline Waltz. The size of [Shield] becomes equal to 30% of this skill’s total damage.

levels.text: Mimi moves as quick as a stray cat, dealing 4 physical attacks equal to 275% of her ATK to enemies at random. The more enemies Mimi defeats, the more her animal instincts are awakened. Each time a target is defeated by this skill, the number of attacks it deals increases by 1 (8 total attacks max).
The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 315% of her ATK.
The number of initial physical attacks becomes 5, and the max total number of attacks becomes 9.

Mimi copies the purr-ty dancer she admires, and performs the dance moves she just memorized. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 260% of her ATK to 3 random enemies. The physical attack’s damage increases by 40% of Mimi’s ATK for each buff she is enhanced with (420% of her ATK max). This skill grants Mimi [Shield] equal to 20% of this skill’s total damage for 4 turns.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 290% of her ATK, and the increase in damage for each buff she is enhanced with becomes equal to 60% of her ATK (530% of her ATK max).
The targets of this skill become 5 random enemies.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 350% of her ATK (590% of her ATK max).

Mimi performs her favorite dance routine. Her moves are full of energy and she feels really paw-some. Starting from the 3rd turn, at the start of each turn, if Mimi has not taken any damage in 2 turns, this skill increases her ATK by 40% for 3 turns (cannot be dispelled).
The amount her ATK increases by becomes 60%.
The amount her ATK increases by becomes 80%.

Dance connects two people together. Those captivated by its allure start dancing, becoming paw-tners in crime. At the start of the battle, Mimi inflicts [Resonance] on the enemy with the highest DEF and the enemy with the lowest DEF (cannot be dispelled). [Resonance] deals 50% of the damage one target takes to the other target. This skill is dispelled when a target afflicted with [Resonance] is defeated.
The damage one target takes from [Resonance] becomes equal to 60% of the damage the other target takes.
The damage one target takes from [Resonance] becomes equal to 80% of the damage the other target takes.

Strengthens Liar’s Sting. The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 340% of her ATK.
Strengthens Liar’s Sting. The chance to inflict [Decreased HP Drain] becomes 60%.

levels.text: A number of knives surround the enemy, but who’s being targeted? And which knife is real? There is only one way to find out. Deals 1 magical attack equal to 260% of Tropon’s ATK to 5 random enemies. She has the insight of a swindler, and can easily figure out her enemies’ weak points. Each time this skill activates, it increases the magical attack’s damage by 70% of her ATK.
Additionally restores HP equal to 20% of this skill’s total damage to her.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 310% of her ATK.

Deception is a swindler’s way of life. Deals 1 magical attack equal to 270% of Tropon’s ATK to 5 random enemies. A hidden knife then flies out of the shadows, dealing 1 direct attack equal to 260% of her MAG to 1 random enemy.
Additionally, if a target is defeated by this skill, increases the number of turns of every buff Tropon is enhanced with by 2.
The direct attack’s damage becomes equal to 320% of her MAG.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 350% of her ATK.
Tropon hides the sad truth by telling a white lie, increasing her max HP by 20% (cannot be dispelled).
The amount her max HP increases by becomes 40%.
Additionally increases her SPD by 20% (cannot be dispelled).

A swindler can go unnoticed even in the moment they’ve stolen something. Such execution is like magic. If an enemy deals a critical hit to Tropon, this skill has a 75% chance to steal 1 buff from that enemy.

Additionally, when an enemy attacks Tropon but does not deal a critical hit, this skill dispels 1 debuff from her, and has a 75% chance to copy the dispelled debuff’s effect on the enemy that attacked her.
The chance to steal a target’s buff, and the chance to dispel her debuff and copy it on a target, each become 100%.

Deals 1 physical attack equal to 560% of her ATK to the 2 enemies with the highest current HP, and has a 20% chance to decrease all targets’ ATK by 50% for 2 turns.

The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 720% of her ATK.

The beautiful Hathor performs this war dance on the battlefield, dealing 1 physical attack equal to 370% of her ATK to 5 random enemies. The ones captivated by her dance are then invited to the world of dreams. If a target is afflicted with a debuff, this skill has a 20% chance to inflict [Fainted] on that target for 1 turn.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 500% of her ATK.
The chance to inflict [Fainted] becomes 40%. Additionally restores HP equal to 15% of this skill’s total damage to Hathor.

Additionally, after the decision to inflict [Fainted] is made, if a target is not afflicted with a debuff, inflicts [Erosion] on that target for 2 turns. Each turn, at the start of the action phase, [Erosion] deals damage equal to 20% of this skill’s total damage.

Once Hathor takes a step forward, the performance must go on. This dance sometimes excites even herself. Starting from the 3rd turn, at the start of each turn, if Hathor has not taken any damage in 2 turns, this skill increases her ATK by 20% for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled).
The amount her ATK increases by becomes 50%.
The amount her ATK increases by becomes 80%.

Hathor is determined to one day venture to her father’s homeland, which lies far into the west. She strengthens her basic attack. When Hathor deals a basic attack, if she deals a critical hit, her chance to inflict a debuff increases by 10% for 1 turn (cannot be dispelled).
The increase in her chance to inflict a debuff becomes 30%.
The increase in her chance to inflict a debuff becomes 50%.

The amount all targets’ DEF increases by becomes equal to 30% of Olivia’s DEF. The amount all targets’ ATK increases by becomes equal to 30% of Olivia’s ATK.

If the one loved by God is hurt, then He will forsake the one who caused them harm. If an enemy deals a critical hit to Olivia, this skill decreases that enemy’s ATK by 15% for 1 turn.
The amount all targets’ ATK decreases by becomes 25%.
The amount all targets’ ATK decreases by becomes 40%.

The heart of the one who hears her song is stolen away, and if the target’s SPD is lower than Primavera’s SPD, this skill has a 15% chance to inflict [Fainted] on them for 1 turn.
The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 410% of her ATK.
The number of physical attacks becomes 4.

Upon hearing Primavera’s song, her little bird flies in for a surprise attack. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 455% of Primavera’s ATK to the enemy directly in front of her. As she sings, wishing for peace, the enemy loses their will to fight. If this skill deals a critical hit to the target, it inflicts [Buff Immunity] on them for 3 turns.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 520% of her ATK.
The targets of this skill become the enemy directly in front of Primavera and the 2 enemies adjacent to that target.

Songs are melodies from the heart. When Primavera fills them with prayers, she reaches through to anyone. At the start of the battle, this skill increases all allies’ ATK by 2% (cannot be dispelled). A target’s ATK is further increased by 2% for each ally other than Primavera who is alive at the start of the battle.
Additionally increases all allies’ SPD by 2% (cannot be dispelled). A target’s SPD is further increased by 2% for each ally other than Primavera who is alive at the start of the battle.
The amounts all targets’ ATK and SPD are increased by each become 3%.

Primavera is determined to become a songstress who will not bring shame to her name. Increases her ATK by 20% (cannot be dispelled) (this increase is calculated towards Primavera’s ATK at the time of this skill’s activation).
The amount her ATK increases by becomes 35%.
Additionally increases her chance to resist a debuff by 100% (cannot be dispelled).

When an ally is attacked or when they evade an attack, this skill restores HP equal to 3% of the total HP Carol is currently missing to her.
